entries.55f0a05023c51559: As its basic management policy, the company states: 'To contribute to the development and rationalization of customers in Japan and overseas, the Group will bring together its comprehensive planning, development and technological capabilities to manufacture and supply advanced products.' As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company aims to expand its business scale by further strengthening its 'comprehensive strength to sustain profitability steadily', conducting advanced technology research and development, and effectively deploying management resources into markets from a global perspective. As priority issues to address, the company lists the creation of new markets through selection and concentration of businesses, the establishment of a production system suited to each location and the development of new markets, and the strengthening of manufacturing and improvement of quality.
